title: Henry's awards
detail: Players' Player and Footballer of the Year, both for the second season running; 39 goals in 51 games.
evidence: Henry was given the accolade of PFA Players' Player of the Year by his fellow peers and the FWA Footballer of the Year by football writers for the second consecutive season.

evidence: The team eclipsed the league record of 42 matches without defeat (set by Nottingham Forest) against Blackburn Rovers and went seven more matches unbeaten until they lost – away to Manchester United in October 2004.
